title: D-0
subtitle: The Resistance
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: D-0, an impressionable little rolling Droid was cobbled together from the odds and ends of a Droidsmith's workshop. In the abusive service of Ochi of Bestoon, and left to run out of batteries on Ochi's ship, BB-8 found D-0 and offered some of his own energy to revive the little guy.
